scene.line: Oh, wonderful! A whole day off to myself!
The beach, cool iced tea, a good book, maybe a nap --
Fairy Mary, I can't find the Meadow Grass measuring tape.
Or the bark pliers. Or the shell trimmers.
What's this? They're all in the supply cabinet.
Thanks, Fairy Mary. Enjoy your day off!
Now where was I?
Fairy Mary, what should we do with the new wheels?
Tin, you know those go to Clank and Bobble.
Oh, right. Thanks, Fairy Mary. Enjoy your day off!
Now let me see, what was I doing?
Fairy Mary, what do we do about the broken table?
Well, fix it, of course!
Okay. Thanks, Fairy Mary. Enjoy your day off!
Teetering teapots, I haven't even had my tea yet!
Sorry to bother you again, Fairy Mary.
I can't find the Twig polisher.
What do you mean you can't find it?
Fairy Mary, Bobble says the wheels are the wrong size.
That's impossible!
Sorry to interrupt, Fairy Mary, but you know that table?
It sort of fell apart.
Moon and stars, what is going on?
You're all acting like you've never tinkered before!
The Twig polisher is always with the bark pliers.
Oh. I guess I didn't see them.
And the wheels are the right size. I measured them!
I wondered about that.
Bobble wasn't wearing his glasses when he checked them.
And if the table fell apart, then make a NEW table.
You DO know how to do that, don’t you?
Of course I know!
Then all of you, flap to it!

line.direction: COPPER, TIN, & TINK EXIT - USE DOOR

scene.line: Some day off this turned out to be.
There's only one thing to do...
Fairy Mary!
What are you doing here?
It's your day off!
I think I'll get more rest here than I will at the beach!
Good night!
